en: I can't promise I won't try anything... but I'd be happy if you'd come along.{wait}{clear}
I see... Then let's make it another time...{wait}{clear}
It's cold today... Aren't you cold?{wait}{clear}
You may be fine, but it makes me cold just looking at you. Here...{wait}{clear}
...I've caused you a lot of trouble... I'm sorry...{wait}{clear}
Please tell me about yourself, Rocus.{wait}{clear}
About me? It isn't interesting... I'm sure.{wait}{clear}
I don't mind... I want to hear it, so won't you tell me?{wait}{clear}
I... was taken in by the Church as a child.{wait}{clear}
Because they discovered the power in these hands...{wait}{clear}
At the Church, I was taught all sorts of things so I could become Pope. Etiquette, and the duties of a Pope.{wait}{clear}
Meanwhile, the bishops around me flattered me in all sorts of ways, since I was the future Pope.{wait}{clear}
Petty things, the kind you use on a kid...{wait}{clear}
Well, back then they fooled me well enough.{wait}{clear}
They may be clergy, but they're human. Nice faces on the outside, and just greedy old men inside.{wait}{clear}
They say all the right things, which makes them far worse than plain villains...{wait}{clear}
While I was fooling and being fooled by people like that, somehow...{wait}{clear}
becoming Pope started to seem ridiculous...{wait}{clear}
Because I felt like I was only being used.{wait}{clear}
So I spent my time idly playing around, and the Vice Pope threw me out of the Holy City...{wait}{clear}
Well, that's about it... A boring story...{wait}{clear}
That's not true... Thank you for telling me.{wait}{clear}By the way... what are your parents doing now, Rocus?{wait}{clear}
Oh, my parents are ordinary people.{wait}{clear}
When I met them after I'd grown up, they felt almost like strangers.{wait}{clear}
Even now we hardly see each other, and we have nothing to say to each other...{wait}{clear}
I'm not good with them... those people.{wait}{clear}......{wait}{clear}
Won't you tell me about your healing hands?{wait}{clear}
...I first noticed the power in my hands when I was eight or nine, I think...{wait}{clear}
The very first time was a puppy I had... It was barely born, and it got run over by a carriage...{wait}{clear}
It was so badly hurt, I thought there was no saving it.{wait}{clear}
What was it even born for? It was still so little, and it didn't know anything...{wait}{clear}
I couldn't stand it dying like that...{wait}{clear}
But while I was stroking the puppy, its bleeding stopped, and its wounds healed...{wait}{clear}
At first I didn't realize. I was just glad the puppy was well again... that my wish had come true.{wait}{clear}
Then it happened a few more times... and the adults noticed my power...{wait}{clear}
The Church... was looking for someone with the healing hands, the mark of the Pope, so they took me in right away.{wait}{clear}
But all the Church had my hands do was treat nobles, royals and rich merchants who gave big donations...{wait}{clear}
Eventually I got tired of it, made up some excuse, and stopped using my power...{wait}{clear}
Because I refuse to be used by others...{wait}{clear}
...It's not like... I need it now... a power like this...{wait}{clear}......{wait}{clear}
Let's go back to the inn...{wait}{clear}
Ha ha ha ha, Rocus. You really are a soft touch.{wait}{clear}
...Be careful. Sometimes it's more than a scratch...{wait}{clear}
Is the wound by your eye all right?{wait}{clear}
Yes, it's no problem. Just a scratch.{wait}{clear}
Well, I'll keep it as a memento of our adventures.{wait}{clear}
＄＄＄＄＄＄... I don't know about your other heroes, but...{wait}{clear}
I can't fight for the sake of others.{wait}{clear}
For me, doing that would be hypocrisy...{wait}{clear}
But... for the woman I love... the girl I love, I can do it...{wait}{clear}
I don't care what happens to this body...{wait}{clear}
I could do anything... I'm sure.{wait}{clear}
Your hair, your gentle voice... I love everything about you.{wait}{clear}
I've... never asked a human woman this before, but...{wait}{clear}
Turning down a man like me... you'll probably regret it, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}
What a deep forest. Surely nobody lives in a place like this...?{wait}{clear}
What have they done...{wait}{clear}The Heavenly Dragon... Did Endymion's blood call it here...?{wait}{clear}
I won't let you do as you please any longer!{wait}{clear}
At the end, the witch stopped moving...{wait}{clear}Something seemed to have happened, but...{wait}{clear}
The Heavenly Dragon...{wait}{clear}So it's finally been revived.{wait}{clear}
Rocus the hero, and ＄＄＄＄＄＄ the angel, you have done well.{wait}{clear}
So you're going back to the Heavens.{wait}{clear}
When you come down to the surface again, come and see me. You're always welcome.{wait}{clear}
Oh, and next time, I don't plan to cause you trouble over silly things.{wait}{clear}
You're going back to the Heavens?{wait}{clear}
Yes...{wait}{clear}But I will surely come back to you.{wait}{clear}...I will stay here as a human.{wait}{clear}
If you can't come back... it's all right...{wait}{clear}
There's no need to throw anything away for someone like me...{wait}{clear}
No... Rocus... I'll come back, I promise...{wait}{clear}We'll... meet again, Rocus.{wait}{clear}
I see...... I hope we meet again.{wait}{clear}
I'll look forward to the day I can call your name once more.{wait}{clear}
